translations.web: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.
translations.bsb: When a man dies, will he live again? All the days of my hard service I will wait, until my renewal comes.
translations.kjv: If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.
translations.asv: If a man die, shall he live again? All the days of my warfare would I wait, Till my release should come.
